complete_examples.text: For the track slab, the longitudinal connection of adjacent slabs has two types: unit type (UT) for CRTS I and CRTS III and longitudinal connected type (LCT) for CRTS II, as shown in Fig. 3.
The maximum magnitude of deformation for the track slab with an LCT base plate is approximately 15–18.7 mm.
